name: Starry Convergent Particle Beam
name_jp: 極星収束式 波動砲
effects:
Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Dark/NE or Lightning/NE magic attacks under En-Dark or En-Lightning + minor DeShell for 5 seconds, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Dark/Lightning/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1 + DeShell 30% for 5 seconds, Instant Cast 1 to user, removes Master Mode
